'''Korriban wine''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Wine/Legends|wine]] from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Xasha]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] drank some while on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
